title: Connect checkpoint restore, replay references, and root validation in one bounded fixture

scope.question: What is the smallest independently checked offline fixture that connects a restored checkpoint, its first replay record, and a provenance-bounded expected root?
include: Only contracts established by the four prerequisite questions
Explicitly supplied and provenance-labeled fixture inputs
exclude: A full storage or consensus component claim

prior_attempts.relation: compact digest reference provenance with external H+1 gap

remaining_gap: The external expected H+1 reference is unresolved, and the selector/writer evidence remains open. Starting an implementation fixture now would silently invent a hard dependency contract.

dependencies.condition: The selected restore-to-replay field relationship is reproduced from its retained packet.
The H+1 input producer or an explicit fixture contract with provenance is established.
The selector path and runtime unknowns are reviewed.
The selected store destination and limits are reviewed with the selector evidence.

downstream_consumer: A small offline checkpoint-to-replay-to-root-validation fixture, the shared consumer of all five pilot questions.
acceptance_requirements: Name and hash every fixture input; use synthetic, offline data only.
Require explicit provenance for an expected-root input and preserve unresolved branches.
Compare only an observable result established by the prerequisite contracts.
Keep captured execution and the full component gate out of scope.

linked_issue.purpose: active checkpoint and state validation work area; issue is an epic, not a task reservation
